metadata.title: Mauritius Weather, 48 Hours
metadata.what_you_will_try: Can you hear the heat of the afternoon build and fade across two days in Mauritius? Listen for the brightest tone, then for the pulse that quickens when the wind picks up.

channels.eddy_vorticity_norm: rain in the hour (precip_1h:mm) over 3 mm
channels.spatial_grid: [temperature, wind speed, wind direction]; direction is where the wind blows from (wind_dir_10m:d) over 360
